blocks.title: What to Look For in Gap Filling
blocks.body:
STEP 1: Read the whole sentence first. 
STEP 2: Identify what TYPE of word is needed (verb/article/preposition/conjunction).
STEP 3: Apply the rule.

COMMON GAPS:
- Articles: a, an, the (or zero article)
- Prepositions: in, on, at, by, for, since, with, from, to
- Tense forms: is/are/was/were/will/have/had
- Modals: can/could/may/might/must/should/would
- Conjunctions: and/but/because/although/so/while
blocks.body_hi:
चरण 1: पूरा वाक्य पहले पढ़ें।
चरण 2: पहचानें कि किस प्रकार का शब्द चाहिए।
चरण 3: नियम लागू करें।

सामान्य अंतराल: Article, Preposition, Tense, Modal, Conjunction
blocks.body_gu: Step 1: Read full sentence. Step 2: Identify gap type. Step 3: Apply rule. Common: Articles, Prepositions, Tense, Modals, Conjunctions.

blocks.title: Solved Example 1: Gap Filling Exercises
blocks.title_hi: हल किया गया उदाहरण 1: रिक्त स्थान भरना (Board Exam)
blocks.title_gu: Solved Ex 1: Gap Filling (Board Exam Pattern)
blocks.problem: Fill in: 'He has been working _____ morning.'
blocks.problem_hi: भरें: 'वह _____ सुबह से काम कर रहा है।'
blocks.solution: SINCE. Rule: FOR + duration (hours, years). SINCE + point of time (morning, Monday, 2020). 'Morning' is a point in time → SINCE.
blocks.solution_hi: SINCE। 'Morning' समय का बिंदु है → SINCE।

blocks.title: Solved Example 2: Gap Filling Exercises
blocks.title_hi: हल किया गया उदाहरण 2: रिक्त स्थान भरना (Board Exam)
blocks.title_gu: Solved Ex 2: Gap Filling (Board Exam Pattern)
blocks.problem: Fill in: 'She is interested _____ learning music.'
blocks.solution: IN. Collocation: interested IN something. Other fixed prepositions: good AT, afraid OF, proud OF, responsible FOR, married TO, famous FOR, fond OF.
blocks.solution_hi: IN। Collocation: interested IN। अन्य: good at, afraid of, proud of।
blocks.solution_gu: interested IN. Fixed prepositions: good AT, afraid OF, proud OF.

blocks.title: Solved Example 3: Gap Filling Exercises
blocks.title_hi: हल किया गया उदाहरण 3: रिक्त स्थान भरना (Board Exam)
blocks.title_gu: Solved Ex 3: Gap Filling (Board Exam Pattern)
blocks.solution: AN. Rule: Use 'AN' before words that start with a VOWEL SOUND (a, e, i, o, u sound). 'Honest' starts with silent 'h' → sounds like 'onest' → vowel sound → AN. Other: an hour (silent h), an heir.
blocks.solution_hi: AN। नियम: 'AN' vowel sound से पहले। 'Honest' में 'h' मौन है → vowel sound → AN।
blocks.solution_gu: AN. 'Honest' = silent h = vowel sound = AN.

blocks.question: Board Gap Fill: 'She has lived here _____ 2015.'
blocks.question_hi: Board: 'वह यहां _____ 2015 से रह रही है।'
blocks.explanation: SINCE. Rule: SINCE + specific point in time (2015, Monday, morning, January). FOR + period (five years, two hours). '2015' is a specific year = point in time → SINCE.
blocks.explanation_hi: SINCE। '2015' एक विशिष्ट वर्ष = समय का बिंदु → SINCE।

blocks.question: Board Gap Fill: 'He is _____ European.'
blocks.explanation: 'A'. Rule: Use A/AN based on SOUND, not spelling. 'European' starts with 'E' but sounds like 'Yoo-ropean' → consonant Y sound → use A. Trick: a European, a university, a one-way street (all start with consonant sound despite vowel letter).

blocks.question: Board Gap Fill: 'The Ganges is _____ sacred river.'
blocks.explanation: 'a'. Rule: 'sacred' starts with consonant sound 's' → use 'A'. Also: 'The Ganges' is already the specific river (using 'the'). We need article for 'sacred river' which is general (a = any sacred river).

blocks.question: Fill in: 'I was tired, _____ I went to sleep early.'
blocks.question_gu: 'I was tired, _____ I went to sleep early.'
blocks.explanation: SO = result/consequence. Tired is the CAUSE, sleeping early is the RESULT. 'I was tired SO I went to sleep.' Compare: BECAUSE (introduces reason/cause), BUT (contrast), ALTHOUGH (concession).
blocks.explanation_hi: SO = परिणाम। थका = कारण → सोना = परिणाम → SO।

blocks.question: Board: 'He succeeded _____ working very hard.'
blocks.explanation: 'BY'. Rule: 'BY + V-ing' shows the METHOD or MEANS by which something is done. 'He succeeded BY working hard.' Also: BY bus, BY phone, BY train = means of transport/communication.
blocks.explanation_hi: 'BY'। BY + V-ing = तरीका/साधन। 'BY working' = मेहनत करके।
